notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.1 Timing and level fixes for the step sequencer. Fixed - Step sequencer ran too slow. When the pattern was shorter than the loop window, the pattern stretched to fill the window instead of repeating inside it — a 1/16 grid could play quarter notes, the playhead crawled, and a snare drawn on beat 2 fired a bar late. The pattern now repeats for as many whole cycles as fit the loop. - The bars dropdown changed the tempo. Switching 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 bars altered the groove speed. Only BPM and the division dropdown affect step rate now. - Piano-roll timing followed the sequencer's error, so melodic parts sat off the drum grid whenever the two disagreed. Rendered and dragged-out clips were affected the same way and now line up with what you hear. - Track faders were too quiet. The track volume was being applied twice, so a fader at half read roughly a quarter. Faders are now linear across their range. - Tracks 12 and above were silent — they started at zero volume with the fader drawn at full. Every track now starts at unity. - Sequencer ruler showed the wrong beat and bar numbers at any division except 1/16. Beat numbers, bar lines and per-track grids now follow the active division, including triplet and dotted grids. Bar lines are drawn heavier than beat lines. - The loop sat on top of the drums. The loop bed now starts about 3 dB lower so the kit reads clearly against it; the fader is there if you want it back.
